children: Nomos, a German energy management platform founded in 2024, has raised 20 million euros ($23.3 million) in new funding, said the company, highlighting opportunities for private equity firms in the sector as European consumers seek cheaper energy bills.
• Nomos said venture capital firm Index Ventures had led this funding round.
• Nomos trades and buys and sells electricity on EPEX Spot, the primary electricity exchange for Germany and much of Europe.
• The Nomos platform also uses AI to try and find the cheapest costs for its customers.
• Nomos' fund-raising comes after the German government announced in July a broad-ranging energy cost relief package for businesses and consumers worth 13.3 billion euros in 2027.
• Energy prices have risen sharply since the start of ​the
, adding to costs faced by German companies and consumers.
